stem.text: A nucleus collides with a stationary nucleus in a vacuum. The diagrams show the paths of the nuclei before and after the collision.
No other particles are involved in the collision.

A.alt: Diagram of particle paths: an arrowed line enters from the left and meets a point, from which two arrowed lines leave, one upwards to the right and one downwards to the right.

B.alt: Diagram of particle paths: an arrowed line enters from the left and meets a point, from which two arrowed lines leave to the right, one upwards and one slightly downwards.

C.alt: Diagram of particle paths: an arrowed line enters from the left and meets a point, from which two arrowed lines leave to the right, one slightly upwards and one downwards.

D.alt: Diagram of particle paths: an arrowed line enters from the left and meets a point, from which two arrowed lines leave, one upwards to the right and one downwards to the left.
